# Referral voucher platform pilot program design (2026-01-21 10:12Z)

_**User**_

You are Cursor acting as a B2B growth strategist,
founder-sales lead, and pilot program designer.

Your task is to design a CLEAR, LOW-FRICTION
pilot program to onboard the FIRST 10 MERCHANTS
for a “Referral Voucher + Merchant Credit” platform.

This pilot is NOT about scale.
It is about proof, learning, and testimonials.

==================================================
1) PILOT GOAL (LOCKED)
==================================================

Prove that:
- merchants understand the value in <10 minutes
- customers actually share vouchers
- referrals convert to real redemptions
- credit feels motivating but controlled

Secondary goals:
- collect objections
- refine messaging
- generate 3–5 strong testimonials

==================================================
2) WHO ARE THE FIRST 10 MERCHANTS (ICP – VERY SPECIFIC)
==================================================

Choose merchants with ALL of the following:
- Local / regional business
- High trust, repeat customers
- Easy-to-understand service or product
- Owner involved in daily operations
- Comfortable with WhatsApp / phone / email

Best categories:
- Cafés & coffee shops
- Salons / barbers
- Gyms / studios
- Tool rental / service businesses
- Small retail with regulars

Avoid:
- big chains
- pure e-commerce
- discount-driven businesses

==================================================
3) HOW YOU APPROACH THEM (NO MARKETING FLUFF)
==================================================

Channel:
- Direct message
- Phone call
- In-person (best)

Opening line (example):
“I’m testing a new way to turn your regular customers
into your best salespeople, without ads.
Can I show you in 10 minutes?”

Do NOT say:
- startup
- beta
- platform
- app

==================================================
4) PILOT OFFER (IRRESISTIBLE BUT CONTROLLED)
==================================================

What they get:
- Free access during pilot
- Setup done with them (white-glove)
- Their own branded voucher
- Weekly Drop enabled
- Direct feedback influence

What YOU get:
- Usage permission
- Feedback calls
- Testimonial if results are positive

No contracts.
No long-term promises.

==================================================
5) PILOT SETUP (PER MERCHANT)
==================================================

Each merchant gets:
- 1 core voucher (simple value)
- 1 weekly drop (limited stock)
- Credit reward set conservatively
- Staff shown how to redeem (5 min)

Example setup:
- Voucher: “–15% for first visit”
- Weekly drop: 30 vouchers, 48h
- Credit: €5 store credit per referral

==================================================
6) PILOT DURATION
==================================================

- 14 days minimum
- 30 days ideal
- One weekly drop minimum

Rule:
If nothing happens in 7 days,
adjust the offer, not the product.

==================================================
7) WHAT YOU TRACK (ONLY THESE METRICS)
==================================================

Per merchant:
- Vouchers shared
- Referrals created
- Redemptions completed
- Credits earned
- Credits used

Ignore:
- impressions
- clicks
- vanity stats

==================================================
8) FEEDBACK LOOP (MANDATORY)
==================================================

After 7–10 days:
- 15 min call
Ask:
1) Did customers understand it?
2) Did staff find it easy?
3) Would you keep this if it cost money?
4) What felt confusing?

Document exact phrases.

==================================================
9) SUCCESS CRITERIA (GO / NO-GO)
==================================================

Pilot is a SUCCESS if:
- ≥5/10 merchants want to continue
- ≥1 referral per merchant per week
- ≥1 credit used per merchant
- No major trust issues

If not:
- messaging changes first
- incentives second
- product last

==================================================
10) TRANSITION TO PAID (SOFT)
==================================================

End of pilot script:
“This has been free while we test.
If we keep this running,
it will be a small monthly fee
plus a tiny cost per successful referral.”

Do NOT push pricing.
Gauge reaction.

==================================================
11) OUTPUT REQUIRED
==================================================

Deliver:
- Merchant selection checklist
- Outreach script (DM / call)
- Pilot setup checklist
- Feedback questions
- Go/No-Go summary template

Now design the pilot program clearly and simply.

## Summary

**File created:** `docs/PILOT_PROGRAM.md`

**Contents:**

1. **Merchant selection checklist**  
   - Section A: 5 must-haves (local, repeat customers, simple offer, owner-led, OK with WhatsApp/phone/email).  
   - Section B: at least one of café, salon, gym, tool rental, small retail.  
   - Section C: exclude chains, pure e‑commerce, discount-only.  
   - Verdict: IN / OUT.

2. **Outreach script**  
   - Short DM/WhatsApp opening.  
   - 10‑minute phone/in‑person flow (hook → what they get → why pilot → close).  
   - Words to avoid: startup, beta, platform, app.  
   - Short replies for: “no time,” “will it cost,” “customers won’t share,” “already have loyalty.”

3. **Pilot setup checklist (per merchant)**  
   - Pre-session: offer, credit, weekly drop.  
   - In-session: 1 voucher, publish, 1 weekly drop, staff redemption demo (≈5 min), go‑live date, feedback call in 7–10 days.  
   - Post: log in tracker, 1‑line recap.

4. **Feedback questions (7–10 day, ~15 min call)**  
   - 4 main: customers understand? staff easy? keep if it cost? what was confusing?  
   - 2 optional: recommend to another merchant? one thing to change?  
   - Overall tone + testimonial possible (Y/N/Later).

5. **Go/No‑Go summary template**  
   - Table: per-merchant vouchers shared, referrals, redemptions, credits earned, credits used.  
   - Success: ≥5/10 continue, ≥1 referral/merchant/week, ≥1 credit used/merchant, no major trust issues.  
   - If NO‑GO: messaging → incentives → product.  
   - Short testimonial table.

6. **Transition-to-paid script**  
   - One short line; no pricing push; only gauge reaction.

---

**How to test (usage):**

- Pick a candidate and run the **Merchant selection checklist** (Section 1).  
- Rehearse **Outreach script** (Section 2) on a call.  
- For a pilot merchant, run **Pilot setup checklist** (Section 3) in one session.  
- At 7–10 days, run **Feedback questions** (Section 4) and capture quotes.  
- At pilot end, complete **Go/No‑Go** (Section 5) and, if GO, use **Transition to paid** (Section 6).

You can print or copy individual sections from `docs/PILOT_PROGRAM.md` for calls and checklists.

## 7. Action Plan — Week by Week

- **Enne starti:** 15–20 kandidaati, kontaktiandmed, demo ja 10 min skript, tracker (tabel).
- **Nädal 1:** Checklist 15–20-le, DM/kõne esimesele 5–7-le, 10 min kohtumised, eesmärk 3–5 “jah”.
- **Nädal 2:** Setup (§3) iga “jah”-iga, kõik 10 elus; kui 7 päeva 0 referraali → muuda pakkumist, mitte toodet.
- **Nädal 3–4:** 7–10. päeva feedback (§4), tracker täituv, 0 korral → üks muutuja (nt krediit või drop).
- **Nädal 4–5:** Go/No-Go (§5), “Kas jätkate?”; kui GO → §6 (Transition to paid).

---

## 8. After Pilot — What to Do Next

- **Kui GO:** §6 skript, 3–5 testimoniali, hind ja “variandid” ainult positiivsetele, järgmised 10 sama ICP-ga.
- **Kui NO-GO:** esmalt messaging, siis incentives, viimasena product; üks muutuja korraga, siis uus piloot.
- **Alati:** kogu feedback + “What we learned” üheleheliseks.

Viimases Pilot Rules osas on viide `BRAND_POSITIONING.md`-ile, et jutt jääks “pay for results” ja “referral” raamide sisse.
